> From K5 code review 2. Destroying a budget with 2 processes takes ~21 ms of virtual time in O(frames) sweeps; it is non-preemptible and scales with object frames, including those an attacker creates. It dominates steward lease-termination latency and shows in driver-wake p99. Pre-existing, not K5's to fix. Schedule before S2 (the steward): make destroy work proportional to the destroyed subtree, or make it preemptible and bounded. K5 records it in the latency table.
